desc: Derive and validate the fixed-frequency DP state and transitions.
Account for deletion, insertion, alphabet-increment operations, and the terminal `'z'` constraint.
Exhaustively validate the candidate-frequency reduction and fixed-frequency DP against an independent brute-force solver.
Run the implementation against the provided examples and targeted edge cases, including all-distinct strings, single-character strings, and many `'z'` characters.
Confirm the final implementation's time and space complexity.
